summary: Feed c080_crc_link to APM is degraded: NPB-01 port 1 ingress has high CRC/alignment errors (0.154%, 7,320 damaged frames) and the final link NPB-01 port 5 -> APM eth1 is dropping 1.76% of packets (83,340 lost). Both are physical-layer losses that corrupt APM transaction visibility.

findings.root_cause: NPB-01 port 1 (input) is receiving damaged frames with CRC/alignment errors at 0.1542% (7,320 frames, 154x threshold). This is a Layer-1 fault on the link into the packet broker - typically a faulty/dirty cable or optic, bent fiber, or duplex/speed mismatch.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM receives corrupted frames that are dropped before analysis; application transactions appear incomplete or reset, latency and error-rate calculations are skewed, and troubleshooting data is unreliable.

recommended_fix.why: CRC/alignment errors cannot be fixed by broker policy - the physical link must be cleaned, reseated, or replaced and duplex/speed verified on both ends to deliver clean frames to the APM.

findings.root_cause: 1.76% path loss between NPB-01 port 5 egress (4,740,120 pkts sent) and APM eth1 ingress (4,656,780 pkts seen) - 83,340 packets lost on the wire. Indicates faulty cable/optic/patch panel or an unmonitored inline device between broker and tool.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM misses ~1 in 57 packets, creating gaps in TCP flows and application transactions; response-time, throughput and error detection are under-reported and APM will flag false retransmits/timeouts.

recommended_fix.why: Loss occurs after the packet broker, so broker config will not help - inspect interface error counters on NPB-01 port 5 and APM eth1, replace cable/optic, and verify no oversubscribed or faulty patch between them.
